Tooltip

A short text label that appears on hover or focus to name or explain a control — never the only place information lives, and never interactive.

Basic usage

Install the package:

pnpm add @design-schema/react

Import the stylesheet once for the app, then the component:

import '@design-schema/react/index.css';
import { Tooltip } from '@design-schema/react';

Examples

Bold
import { Tooltip, Button } from '@design-schema/react';

<Tooltip content="Bold"><Button label="Bold" /></Tooltip>
6 rows

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescriptionPlatforms
content requiredstring—

The tooltip text. One short phrase or sentence; no markup, no links, no line breaks.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
children requiredcontent—

Exactly one focusable element (a Button, Link, Input). The tooltip attaches to it; a non-focusable child is an error, because keyboard users could never see the tooltip.

Accessibility: The child must be focusable so hover and focus are equivalent (WCAG 1.4.13, 2.1.1).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
placementtop | bottom | start | endtop

Preferred side; flips when it would overflow the viewport (on native, measured with measureInWindow like Popover). `start`/`end` are logical and mirror in right-to-left writing.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
describesbooleantrue

`true`: the tooltip is supplementary and becomes the child's accessible description (aria-describedby). `false`: the tooltip IS the child's name (an icon-only button whose label equals the tooltip) and is linked as aria-labelledby instead — set this when the child has no visible text and its `label` equals `content`, to avoid announcing it twice.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
openboolean—

Controlled visibility, for stories and tests only (the Keyboard story renders the tooltip open with it). Product code never sets it: a tooltip is hover and focus driven.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
delaydefault | nonedefault

Hover delay before showing: `default` uses `motion.duration.base` × 3 (roughly 600ms, so casual mouse movement does not flash tooltips); `none` for toolbars where a sibling tooltip is already open (a shared "warm" state so moving along a toolbar shows tooltips instantly: after a tooltip hides, siblings show with no delay for one motion.duration.loop; the pointer may cross to the tooltip within one motion.duration.fast before it hides).

web, lit, rn, swiftui

Accessibility

Decisions this component leaves to you

Required props that carry accessibility meaning: children. Each is described in the props table above.

Implicit ARIA role: tooltip.

Anatomy

triggerpopuptext

What generation guarantees

Escape dismisses — Escape closes it from anywhere inside.

Keyboard operable — Everything the pointer can do here, the keyboard can do — see the keyboard section.

Contrast — Text and meaningful non-text contrast meets WCAG AA; the pairs are listed below.

Reduced motion — Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the transitions are dropped rather than shortened, and the component still reaches every state.

No hover-only content — Nothing is reachable by hover alone; keyboard focus reveals the same content.
